terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.accept: I accept the Terms of Service
terms.mustAccept: You must accept the terms to continue
terms.section1Body: Pixio is a software platform that connects independent professionals with clients. Pixio is NOT a general contractor, employer, or party to any service agreement. All work agreements are between the client and the contractor.
terms.section2Body: You expressly agree NOT to arrange cash payments or payments outside the Pixio platform. Until a payment is deposited in escrow, contact information (phone numbers, emails, external links) is automatically masked in chat. Violating this clause may result in permanent account suspension.
terms.section3Body: In the event of an unresolved dispute, both parties agree that the Pixio audit team will review photographic evidence and digital contract specifications to determine a refund or partial/total release of retained funds. This decision is binding.
terms.section4Body: Each accepted quote generates an immutable record in our database with timestamp, IP address, and accepted terms. This record constitutes a binding digital contract between client and contractor.
terms.section5Body: For projects over $1,000, funds are divided into milestones (typically 30/40/30). Each milestone is charged and held individually. Funds release automatically 48 hours after 'Work Completed' unless a dispute is opened.
terms.section6Body: Pixio charges a 15% commission on each released milestone and change order. The contractor receives 85% of the released amount.
